title: Capture of Río Hondo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of Río Hondo", at revision 1370609473, opens: "The Capture of Río Hondo was the result of a Spanish military operation in the autumn of September 1779 against British settlements around the Hondo River in present-day Belize." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5037053, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1779 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
